reference: R176 seed42 and dense-native native comparisons, different 9.362 um grid and depth window
display: Original 0–255; 1 px per input pixel; no rotation or enhancement

operator.forward: Dark background with sparse soft or isolated bright regions, including center-left and the outer top and lower margin.
operator.reverse: Broad mid-left response, isolated upper-right patch and oblique broad band at lower right. Several responses are adjacent to fissure-like or fiber-like structures in the central CT.
operator.previous_models: Different contrast and broad responses, with no trackable new strokes or line in this same neighborhood. No direct per-pixel comparison across grids.

independent_lead.reverse: Broad oblique band and patches in lower half, overlapping patterns from fibers or fissure-like areas.

limits: One fixed surface neighborhood, depth window and model. Physical sheet identity, training exposure, and absence of ink are undetermined.
